main.summary: Data protection with RSA and AES-GCM.

method.name: DecryptArray
method.summary: Decrypts an in-memory envelope by dispatching to the codec for the detected envelope version.
method.param: Serialized envelope.
Certificate containing the private key for decryption.
Additional authenticated data supplied by the caller.
method.returns: Recovered plaintext, or null if the input is invalid or unsupported.

method.name: DecryptArrayAsync
method.summary: Decrypts an in-memory envelope asynchronously by dispatching to the codec for the detected envelope version.
method.param: Serialized envelope.
Certificate containing the private key for decryption.
Additional authenticated data supplied by the caller.
Cancellation token.
method.returns: Recovered plaintext, or null if the input is invalid or unsupported.

method.name: DecryptStream
method.summary: Decrypts an envelope stream using the current supported codec pipeline.
method.param: Input stream containing the serialized envelope.
Output stream for recovered plaintext.
Certificate containing the private key for decryption.
Additional authenticated data supplied by the caller.
method.returns: True if decryption succeeds; otherwise false.

method.name: EncryptArray
method.summary: Encrypts an in-memory payload using the current write codec.
method.param: Plaintext payload.
Certificate containing the public key for encryption.
Optional additional authenticated data.
True to bind a hash of caller-supplied AAD into the envelope.
True to include the original length in the envelope header.
Base-2 exponent used to determine chunk size.

method.name: GetEncryptedCapacity
method.summary: Estimates the serialized envelope size for the current write codec without duplicating version-specific layout math at the call site.
method.param: Certificate containing the public key used to determine wrapped key material length.
Plaintext length in bytes.
True to include the optional AAD hash field in the estimate.
True to include the optional original length field in the estimate.
Base-2 exponent used to determine chunk size.
method.returns: Estimated envelope size in bytes, or null if the requested layout is invalid.

method.name: GetEnvelopeVersionArray
method.summary: Extracts the leading envelope version byte from an array input.
method.param: Serialized envelope bytes.
method.returns: The detected version byte, or null if unavailable.

method.name: GetEnvelopeVersionSpan
method.summary: Extracts the leading envelope version byte from a span input.
method.param: Serialized envelope bytes.
method.returns: The detected version byte, or null if unavailable.

method.name: GetEnvelopeVersionStream
method.summary: Reads and returns the leading envelope version byte from a stream input.
method.param: Input stream containing serialized envelope bytes.
method.returns: The detected version byte, or null if unavailable.

remarks.para: This method consumes one byte from the stream. Stream decryption wraps the stream in a to replay the consumed byte for the selected codec.

remarks.para: This method consumes one byte from the stream. Stream decryption wraps the stream in a to replay the consumed byte for the selected codec.
